reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate OBI Energy Tracker
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired or requires renewal. Please sign in via OBI to continue.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the OBI Energy Tracker service. Please check your internet connection.

init.title: Log out of OBI Energy Tracker
init.description: Ends the OBI session and revokes the stored tokens. You will then be asked to log in again. Devices, entities and history are kept.
